title: SimWorks Studios Releases Native PC-12 Legacy for MSFS 2024 with Rebuilt Flight Model
summary: SimWorks Studios has officially released its Pilatus PC-12/47 Legacy for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, bringing the popular single-engine turboprop to the latest simulator with a substantially updated flight model, improved avionics and numerous additional features.
body:
The aircraft is available now directly from SimWorks Studios, priced at €34.99, with existing customers who purchased the FS2020 version eligible for a 50% upgrade discount.

![](/assets/Microsoft_Flight_Simulator_2024_Screenshot_2026.10.30_-_00.00.23.21.png)

## Rebuilt for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024

Rather than simply transferring the existing aircraft to the new simulator, SimWorks Studios has rebuilt the PC-12 around the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 SDK.

Among the principal improvements are an FS2024-native computational fluid dynamics (CFD) flight model, a newly modelled engine bay and updated Working Title v2 avionics.

The release also introduces a functional in-flight entertainment system, expanding the aircraft's appeal for enthusiasts interested in executive and business aviation operations.

## Official MOZA Yoke Support

SimWorks Studios has also introduced official control presets for the MOZA AY210 and AY90 yokes.

Available as free extras, the presets are designed to provide a more representative PC-12 handling experience for pilots using compatible MOZA hardware.

![](/assets/4_days.png)

## Pricing and Availability

The PC-12 Legacy is available directly from SimWorks Studios for €34.99.

Customers who previously purchased the PC-12 for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 through SimWorks Studios will receive a 50% discount, automatically applied before checkout.

The developer plans to distribute the aircraft to third-party retailers on Monday 2 November, while the Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace release is expected within approximately one to two weeks. These dates remain estimates until availability is confirmed.

The aircraft is distributed through the SWS Installer, which has been updated to version 0.0.46 to support the new release.

## A Welcome Addition to Business Aviation

Although the Pilatus PC-12 is a turboprop rather than a jet, its versatility and popularity in executive transport make it a relevant addition to the growing selection of business aviation aircraft available for MSFS 2024.

With revised flight dynamics, upgraded avionics and enhanced cockpit functionality, the new release gives PC-12 enthusiasts an opportunity to explore the aircraft's capabilities in the latest simulator.
